Obtain the filed petition, temporary support materials, and draft property division schedule from Rowan Thimblefern at Lavender Sprocket Family Law for Celia Bramblequill's planning file.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-11-08", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Rowan Thimblefern at Lavender Sprocket Family Law has the filed petition, temporary support materials, and draft property division schedule, but those records are not yet in Apricot Compass Advisory's planning file; the agreed follow-up is to obtain them by November 8, 2024."},
{"templateId": "1657c4bd-a5da-5150-95d5-7425264214fc", "title": "Review beneficiary designations on a recurring cadence", "text": "Every year, and whenever there is a major household, employment, retirement, estate, or account ownership change, review beneficiary designations for retirement accounts, life insurance, annuities, transfer-on-death registrations, education accounts, and estate document alignment. Confirm whether updates are needed, collect signed custodian or carrier forms through secure channels, and document completion in the planning record. Review Celia Bramblequill's beneficiary designations, transfer-on-death registrations, retirement account records at Velvet Acorn Custody and Paper Otter Studio, and her $750,000 term life insurance policy, which currently lists Soren as primary beneficiary, in light of the separation.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-11-15", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Celia requested a review of beneficiary designations, transfer-on-death registrations, retirement account records, and life insurance beneficiary information in light of the separation from Soren; the agreed review date is November 15, 2024."},
{"templateId": "c393e96a-1c64-5f18-a7c7-de00eb34b4b0", "title": "Coordinate access recovery request", "text": "Use this template when a client, household member, or authorized staff member cannot access an approved portal or account platform. Confirm identity using firm procedures, identify the affected system, document the error or access issue, coordinate the reset path, and confirm successful access without requesting or storing passwords. Celia Bramblequill's secure document portal login fails because the multifactor prompt still goes to a phone number used during the marriage; update the MFA contact and restore her access.", "priority": "high", "dueDate": "2024-11-04", "assigneeId": "548898b3-c716-58ab-84a8-f0e6c7b260ee", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Celia reported that her secure document portal login fails because the multifactor prompt still goes to a phone number used during the marriage; portal access recovery was agreed for November 4, 2024."},
{"templateId": null, "title": "Reconcile joint brokerage balance discrepancy", "text": "Trace the difference between Celia Bramblequill's personal household balance sheet, which lists the joint taxable brokerage account at $642,200, and the current Velvet Acorn Custody feed showing $611,480, before the legal team uses the planning figures.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-11-07", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Celia's personal household balance sheet lists the joint brokerage account at $642,200, while the current Velvet Acorn Custody feed shows $611,480, and Celia asked for the difference to be traced before the legal team uses the planning figures; the agreed date is November 7, 2024."},
{"templateId": "3f101160-7da3-5912-9f24-ef2bb986fe5f", "title": "Send tax document collection outreach", "text": "Subject: Tax document collection for planning review

Hello Galen Nettlewhisk,

We are preparing the tax-related portion of Celia Bramblequill's planning review. Please provide the applicable documents through [secure upload method] when available:

- Most recent federal and state tax returns
- W-2, 1099, K-1, and other income forms
- Estimated tax payment records
- Charitable contribution summaries
- Capital gain/loss reports or realized gain summaries
- Retirement contribution and distribution forms
- Any tax notices or amended return information

If another professional should provide these materials, please share the best contact information or let us know whether we should send a separate secure request.

Thank you,
[advisor or service team name]

Coordinate with Galen Nettlewhisk at Cloudberry Kite Tax Group for the prior joint return, year-to-date pay information, withholding records, and estimated tax payment history for cash-flow materials being assembled for counsel.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-11-12", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Celia asked Apricot Compass Advisory to coordinate with Galen Nettlewhisk for the prior joint return, year-to-date pay information, withholding records, and estimated tax payment history for cash-flow materials being assembled for counsel; that outreach was agreed for November 12, 2024."},
{"templateId": "64965e2a-7e0f-5b3e-9bde-148c1b66e2b4", "title": "Review concentrated position risk and evidence", "text": "Evaluate the concentrated position using these criteria and evidence requirements:

Criteria to review:
- Position size as a percentage of total portfolio and investable assets
- Cost basis, unrealized gain or loss, and holding period
- Tax lot availability and charitable gifting potential
- Employer exposure, compensation link, or insider trading restrictions if applicable
- Liquidity needs and planned spending horizon
- Diversification impact under base, downside, and upside scenarios
- Client risk tolerance and emotional or legacy attachment to the position
- Restrictions from blackout windows, lockups, pledges, margin, or legal agreements

Evidence to collect:
- Current holding statement or portfolio report
- Tax lot report with acquisition dates and cost basis
- Applicable equity compensation plan documents or trading policy
- Prior tax return capital gain schedules when relevant
- Client notes on spending needs, charitable intent, and sale preferences
- Advisor-approved scenario output comparing hold, staged sale, hedge, gift, or exchange alternatives

Analyze the Clockwork Clover Systems shares valued at $252,900 in Celia Bramblequill's joint taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody, including cost-basis, tax-lot, and liquidity analysis, before any proposed division or sale discussion.", "priority": "high", "dueDate": "2024-11-22", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the Clockwork Clover Systems position represents a large share of the joint brokerage account and needs cost-basis, tax-lot, and liquidity analysis before any proposed division or sale discussion; the agreed review date is November 22, 2024."}
]}
